description: Trigger generator whose pulses arrive at random intervals, drawn from the exponential distribution that describes radioactive decay, at an average rate you set

params.text: Sets the average number of triggers per second, from 0.0001 to 100, marked in becquerels
At 0% the interval to the next trigger is drawn fresh each time and varies widely; at 100% every interval is the same length, which turns the output into an even clock at the rate set by RATE

inputs.text: Scales the rate set by the RATE knob, and reads 10V when nothing is patched: 5V halves the rate, and 0V or any negative voltage stops the triggers altogether
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the spacing of the triggers comes from the STABILITY knob alone, despite the maker's tooltip calling it Stability CV

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse at 10V, one for each trigger

notes: the module runs from its own timing, so it produces triggers with nothing patched into it.
the green lamp flashes on each trigger, and holds at half brightness whenever the rate has fallen to zero and no triggers are being produced.

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 10V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
